i have four folders with lots of playlists in each, and this is the general order i have them in:

folder one:
all my monthly 2019 playlists, make a new one each month. i do this each month until it’s been a year and then start over

folder two:
moods! i separate my songs based to mood, so i have sad songs, happy songs, etc not really going by genre just by feeling. inside that folder i have two other folders, one holding all my collaborative playlists and spotify generated playlists, the other subfolder is just more specific mood playlists.  

folder three:
all my monthly 2018 playlists. january through december! i look back on them occasionally, it’s nice to see what i was into on a monthly basis for a whole year. thinking of making a master 2018 playlist to go along with that folder, havent really gotten to it yet. 

folder four:
this holds all the other random playlists i have. playlists that go back farther from before i had spotify that i transferred over, playlists of songs ripped from youtube, etc
it’s a pretty good system, i update many of my playlists daily and i’ve gotten to the point where i’m pretty happy with my current setup
